subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools) - draft & owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acme-retail.com>; Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>; Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration build plan)

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps while it’s fresh:

Summary from call:
- Goal: Integrate Redwood hosted API for product search assistant in Acme mobile and web. Primary features: SDK-based streaming responses, tool calling for inventory lookups, and structured output (JSON) for UI rendering.
- Target internal pilot: 2 feature pages (web checkout assistant + mobile product details).
- Timeline: target contract signature by end of Q2; we discussed a tentative close date of 2026-06-30.

Attached: initial MAP draft (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a short SDK integration spec (sdk-integration-spec.md). The MAP includes milestones; below I pulled out the integration build milestone for clarity.

MAP milestone: Integration build plan (owner assignments) — proposed
- Milestone name: SDK Integration, Streaming & Tooling
- Target complete: 2026-05-15
- Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel (SDK integration, streaming endpoints, auth)
- Owner (Acme): Priya Menon (point of contact, SDK embed in mobile/web, QA lead)
- Dependencies: final API keys, staging VPC access for dedicated testing, inventory tool API docs and mock endpoints from Acme, acceptance criteria doc (see tab in MAP).
- Acceptance criteria: streaming responses under 400ms p50 for 1k tokens, tool call latency <250ms, structured JSON schema v1 validated in UI.

As next steps:
1) Priya / Tom: confirm owners and target complete date for this milestone (reply inline).
2) Dev / Sean: I can queue a short tech kickoff (30 min) next week to review the SDK auth flow and streaming sample; propose Wed 2026-03-18 or Fri 2026-03-20.
3) I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with agreed dates and share a DocuSign-ready statement of work once we lock timeline.

If this looks right I’ll mark the milestone owner rows in the MAP and move to the next set (security/compliance and canary deployment).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
- sdk-integration-spec.md (text, 18KB)

From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration build plan)

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. Priya and I reviewed the MAP and the integration milestone looks good. Couple of notes:

- Agree with Dev being the Redwood owner. On Acme side, I’ll own coordination with our infra team for the staging VPC; Priya will drive the SDK integration in the product teams.
- We have an internal freeze the week of 2026-04-06 for a separate release; would prefer the critical integration tests to run before that date if possible. Can we target a first-pass internal test by 2026-04-01?
- Inventory tool mock endpoints: Priya will send mock schemas by EOD next Monday (2026-03-16).

On the kickoff: Wed 2026-03-18 at 10:00 PT works for me.

Tom
VP Product Engineering, Acme Retail
tom.rivers@acme-retail.com

Marissa / team —

Confirmed: Priya (Acme) = SDK integration owner; Tom = infra/staging owner. We’ll aim for internal test 2026-03-31 as discussed with product leads (a bit earlier than Tom’s preferred 2026-04-01).

I attached the first version of the inventory mock (see link in MAP tab). Also flagged one dependency: our security team needs to validate streaming connection patterns (long-lived connections) for compliance; I’ll loop in security if there’s anything blocking.

I’ll be on the kickoff Wed 2026-03-18 10:00 PT.

Thanks —
Priya Menon

priya.menon@acme-retail.com

Great — thanks all for the quick confirmations. Action items I’ve taken and owners updated in the MAP:

- Updated milestone target: Integration build plan: target internal test 2026-03-31, target completion 2026-05-15.
- Owners set: Dev Patel (Redwood eng owner); Priya Menon (Acme product/QA owner); Tom Rivers (Acme infra/staging).
- Dev / Sean: please prepare the SDK sample repo and a streaming example (tokenized sample) ahead of Wed kickoff; mark any infra requirements (CORS, allowed origins, port ranges) in the shared spec.
- Priya: please share the inventory mock link and the security contact for streaming validation before the kickoff.

I’ve uploaded the updated MAP (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) to the HubSpot deal record and linked it above. If anything changes before the kickoff I’ll send an updated invite. Looking forward to the call.

Cheers —
